test_title: SSC CGL 2023 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On: 21 Jul 2023 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: The area of the sector of a circle of radius 28 cm is 112 cm². Find the length of the corresponding arc of the sector.
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Area of Sector = (1/2) × Radius × Arc length

112 = (1/2) × 28 × l

112 = 14 × l

l = 112 / 14 = 8 cm

**∴ The correct option is B.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Radius (r) = 28 cm

Area of sector (A) = 112 cm²

**Formula Used:**

Area of sector = (Arc length × Radius) / 2

 

 r = 28 cm
 Area = 112 cm²
 Arc length (l) = ?
 Sector of a Circle

**Calculations:**

⇒ 112 = (l × 28) / 2

⇒ 112 = l × 14

⇒ l = 112 / 14

⇒ l = 8 cm

**∴ The correct option is B.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Arc Length Formula

The length of an arc (l) with central angle θ is given by l = (θ/360) × 2πr.

Sector Area Formula

The area of a sector (A) with central angle θ is given by A = (θ/360) × πr².

Perimeter of a Sector

The total perimeter of a sector is the sum of the arc length and the two radii: P = l + 2r.

Relationship between Area and Arc Length

Area of sector = (1/2) × r × l, where r is the radius and l is the arc length.</p
